This inhibition leads to the activation of the endoplasmic reticulum aminopeptidase 2, implying a potential role in modulating protein degradation processes within the ER. The observed scores indicate a plausible but not definitive link between Sikkimenoid C and the target enzyme, supported by a chain of interactions that suggests a possible regulatory pathway. The mechanism involves a cascade of molecular interactions, with the endoplasmic reticulum aminopeptidase 2 likely being a downstream effector in this pathway.
